claim.claim-text: 2. The introducer sheath system of claim 1, additionally comprising a radiopaque ring (72) at the distal portion of the tubular wall structure (34).
3. The introducer sheath system of claim 2, wherein the radiopaque ring (72) comprises a highly elastic polymer.
4. The introducer sheath system of claim 2 or claim 3, wherein the radiopaque ring (72) is adhered to the outside of the elastic outer tubular layer (40).
5. The introducer sheath system of claim 2 or claim 3, wherein the radiopaque ring (72) is adhered inside the elastic outer tubular layer (40).
6. The introducer sheath system of any preceding claim, wherein the elastic outer tubular layer (40) and inner tubular layer (42) are seamless.

7. The introducer sheath system of any preceding claim, wherein the inner tubular layer (42) comprises a thick wall portion (62) comprising a first longitudinally extending end (66) and a second longitudinally extending end (68), and a thin wall portion (64) extending between the first longitudinally extending end (66) and the second longitudinally extending end (68).
8. The introducer sheath system of any preceding claim, wherein the elastic outer tubular layer (40) comprises a plurality of longitudinal rods (60).

9. A method of assembling an introducer sheath system, wherein the introducer sheath system comprises a sheath member (8) comprising a tubular structure (34), wherein the tubular structure (34) comprises an elastic outer tubular layer (40) and an inner tubular layer (42), the method comprising:
10. The method of claim 9, further comprising adhering a radiopaque ring (72) to the outside of the reflowed, distal portion of the elastic outer tubular layer (40).
11. The method of claim 10, wherein the radiopaque ring (72) is adhered by heat shrinking.
12. The method of claim 9, further comprising adhering a radiopaque ring (72) inside the reflowed, distal portion of the elastic outer tubular layer (40).
13. The method of claim 10 or claim 12, wherein the radiopaque ring (72) is adhered by reflowing.
